design.linked_copy_of_key_4: moves with its block; excluded from every statistic, floor and support count

interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.choice: episode = unique row; dependence group = block index (the protocol's exchangeable unit)
interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.topic: episode and dependence group in synthetic rows
interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.why: support_accounting falls back to row_id for episodes and to one 'unknown' group, which would refuse every hypothesis

interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.choice: matched = matched unique rows; observed = matched rows observed; worst case = sum over matched slots of the minimum slot mask across blocks of the slot's stratum; transition/sequence additionally need worst-case observed >= 1
interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.topic: matched / observed floors and worst-case bound
interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.why: protocol gives the bound in words; metric must be defined for every draw

interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.choice: refuses all 384 hypotheses of the world (hypothesis-level)
refused only when the outcome column is constant over observed rows (constant across the permutation group); an exactly zero observed lift is NOT refused
interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.why: refusing zero lifts would refuse most categorical hypotheses under N1 and trip the 1% blocker

interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.choice: coverage, jumps, persistence noise, categorical labels

interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.choice: the world stays in the ECDF denominator and its null p counts as not <= t
interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.topic: marginal calibration when h(w) is refused

interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.why: p can equal the threshold exactly (1+X = 100k)

interpretations_flagged_for_owner_review.choice: reference path only (production _metric import); no vectorized rewrite, so no equivalence proof is needed or offered

multiplicity.exact_rule: reject the k* smallest, k* = max k with 7680*(1+X_(k)) <= k*(B+1) (integer arithmetic)

null_mad.t3_derivation: deterministic Gauss-Legendre + bisection of the frozen mixture; verified by preflight and the independent verifier

power_worlds.pairing: pre-injection family from streams 0 and 1 of tuple (20,c,P,w); injection from stream 3

refusal.blocking_rate: 1/100 of worlds; 1/100 of (world, hypothesis) pairs over 384 x non-refused worlds
